svg.title: Suhina colour palette: original, simulated CVD and greyscale
svg.desc: Twenty-four numbered swatches on light and dark surfaces. Simulations are an approximation, not a guarantee of distinguishability.
svg.text: Design check: colour is an aid; names, order and selection outlines must remain usable.
Machado et al. (2009/2010), linear sRGB matrices; clip to display gamut, encode to sRGB.
Published numerical data checked in Colour Science's BSD-3-Clause dataset. Tritan is an approximation.
Red/green and some blue/purple distinctions collapse; greyscale preserves only luminance.
No claim that all 24 swatches are distinguishable. Use track names, grouping and focus outlines.
